scope: Synthetic-only caller-side admission guard for the DAT-08 raw-source constructor component.

proposed_contract.freeze_gate: observed_at >= 2026-09-14T10:00:00Z plus explicit status=frozen weight and harness receipt
proposed_contract.semantic_receipt_extension: case_bindings keyed by the exact requested row IDs, with split_identity, source_sha256, context_sha256, and target_sha256 for every case
proposed_contract.source_allowlist: one or more caller-supplied absolute real directories; every source must be a regular non-symlink file below one selected root
proposed_contract.disjointness: duplicate final row/split identities and row/package/group/split intersections with TRAIN or DEV memberships reject before source byte reads
proposed_contract.source_read: root-relative O_NOFOLLOW directory walk, regular-file and inode identity check, then expected source SHA-256 check
proposed_contract.output: temporary O_EXCL write, file fsync, exclusive hard-link, parent-directory fsync, cleanup; existing outputs and filesystem errors reject without replacement

coverage: valid synthetic byte handoff and manifest binding
freeze time and explicit authorization before source reads
positive allowlist and symlink escape rejection
TRAIN/DEV and duplicate final identity rejection
stale or forged semantic source/context/target binding rejection
source replacement after metadata gate rejection
existing output preservation and no-overwrite behavior
